prompt:
Create ONE key sheet for the human of a silent animated film, shot s01. Use case: illustration-story. Plate family 'lid' (3 keys: K1, K2, K3). Pure black sheet, two rows, 16:9.
REFERENCE ROLES. Image 1 is the approved MODEL SHEET of the human: keep this exact character (green skin, mauve-and-blue angular poncho, one trailing swoop of cream-and-mauve hair, large hands, flared trousers and boots), the same proportions (about eight heads tall, long thin limbs), the same flat colours with identity pigments, and the same thin pale contour (about one 166th of the figure's height). Image 2 is the approved pick: its line quality, tapered tips and stipple shadow. Image 3 is the cinematography sheet of the shot: use it only for ROW 2 (camera, the plain box, Codex and Clawd, the blue light). Image 4 is a POSE GUIDE: for each key a pale stick figure of the spine, shoulders, hips and legs on one baseline, numbered K1, K2, K3. Draw the human so that her spine follows the guide's curve, her hips and feet stand where the guide's do and the same foot carries the weight; the arms are NOT in the guide, draw them as the words say. Do not copy the guide's lines, dots or numerals into the picture.
ROW 1 (upper 70 percent of the sheet): 3 full-length figures of the SAME human, left to right, numbered K1, K2, K3 in cream numerals under each, each figure FULL LENGTH with both boots visible, all at exactly the same scale (about 62 percent of the sheet height) on one shared pale baseline, flat shapes, pale contour, stipple shadow, no gradients, no box and no props in row 1 (draw the hands where the invisible lid would be), every pose on ONE clear line of action, the silhouette reading when filled black (arms, hands and legs apart from the torso mass where the pose allows it). Keep the head, the hair swoop, the poncho and the trousers identical in design to the model sheet.
POSES:
K1 (rest-on-lid, frame 0): Upright behind the box, weight even, forearms resting on the lid's near edge, chin down, eyes on the lid. Line of action: the spine is ONE C curve: its belly bows to the image-left by about 6 percent of the figure's height away from the straight line from hips to head; the head sits about 12 degrees right of straight above the hips. Weight even on both feet. No arm or leg leads. Silhouette kind: closed. It is a deliberate symmetric pose: the poster pose: even weight and both forearms resting the same way on the lid is the point of the first frame.
K2 (grip, frame 42): Shoulders drop and round, elbows bend, fingertips curl under the lid's near edge: the gather before the lift. Line of action: the spine is ONE C curve: its belly bows to the image-left by about 10 percent of the figure's height away from the straight line from hips to head; the head sits about 18 degrees right of straight above the hips. Weight on the image-right foot (the hips sit 60 percent of the way toward it from the other foot), the other foot light. The image-right arm leads. Silhouette kind: fold. It is a deliberate symmetric pose: both hands take the lid's near edge together: the gather is a matched grip, and the asymmetry starts on the lift, where the right arm leads.
K3 (lift, frame 66): Arms rise to chest height pulling the lid, torso straightens and leans a little back, chin lifts. Line of action: the spine is ONE C curve: its belly bows to the image-right by about 6 percent of the figure's height away from the straight line from hips to head; the head sits about 8 degrees left of straight above the hips. Weight on the image-right foot (the hips sit 70 percent of the way toward it from the other foot), the other foot light. The image-right arm leads; the image-left leg leads. Silhouette kind: open. Do NOT draw the two arms or the two legs as mirror twins.
ROW 2 (lower 30 percent): the same 3 keys as small 16:9 frame thumbnails numbered F1, F2, F3 under them, each at the shot's camera: the locked medium-wide poster camera: the plain hip-high box in front of the human, Codex small on the left and Clawd small on the right, the hairline of blue light on the lid seam; the human at the size the cinematography sheet draws her, one emitter in blue (#0a51fb) with the yellow accent (#fad204) only as the second colour of the pair, black field. These thumbnails are staging proof only.
No other text. Do not add background scenery to row 1.
